athar-report-doc-title: Default HTML document title for printable reports.
athar-report-brand-subtitle: Subtitle below Athar brand title in report header.
athar-report-generated-at: Label preceding report generation UTC timestamp.
athar-report-ready-banner: Top action bar heading visible on screen before printing.
athar-report-ready-hint: Helper instruction explaining browser PDF printing.
athar-report-single-project-title:
Document title for single project dossier. Parameters:
* $1 - project title.
athar-report-status-prefix:
Status badge prefix on single project report. Parameters:
* $1 - localized status label.
athar-report-period-all: Scope label when no date filter is applied.
athar-report-period-range:
Scope label for custom date range. Parameters:
* $1 - YYYY-MM-DD start date.
* $2 - YYYY-MM-DD end date.
athar-report-period-year:
Scope label for calendar year. Parameters:
* $1 - 4-digit year.
athar-report-period-month:
Scope label for month filter. Parameters:
* $1 - month value.
athar-report-community-executive: Header badge for community summary executive report.
athar-report-community-detailed: Header badge for detailed community report (detailed=1).
athar-report-community-table-heading:
Table heading on community report. Parameters:
* $1 - count of listed activities.
athar-report-community-full-dossiers:
Section heading for detailed activity cards in community report. Parameters:
* $1 - count of activities.
athar-report-community-empty: Empty message on community report when no projects match scope.
athar-report-user-summary-title: Header badge for contributor portfolio summary report.
athar-report-user-detailed-title: Header badge for detailed contributor portfolio report.
athar-report-user-system-status: Contributor status row label in user report.
athar-report-user-member: Status text for registered community members.
athar-report-user-participant: Status text for non-rostered activity contributors.
athar-report-user-top-wikis: Table heading for top Wikimedia wikis in user report.
athar-report-user-col-wiki: Column header for Wikimedia project in user report.
athar-report-user-col-edits: Column header for edit count in user report.
athar-report-user-ledger: Heading for activity ledger table in user report.
athar-report-user-dossiers:
Heading for detailed project cards in user report. Parameters:
* $1 - count of participated activities.
athar-report-user-role-in-activity: Row label for user's role within an activity.
athar-report-user-all-organizers: Row label listing all organizers of an activity.
athar-report-activity-index:
Sequential activity card prefix. Parameters:
* $1 - 1-based activity index.
athar-report-time-period: Table label for activity date span.
athar-report-time-since:
Partial date range label when only start_date exists. Parameters:
* $1 - start date.
athar-report-no-description: Fallback italic message when activity has empty description.
athar-report-registered-participants:
Participants section heading in detailed reports. Parameters:
* $1 - participant count.
athar-report-exec-summary: Executive summary label in detailed results.
athar-report-jury-notes: Jury notes label in printable reports.
athar-report-winners-rank: Column header for contest placement rank.
athar-report-role-lead: Role name for activity Lead Organizer.
athar-report-role-organizer: Combined organizer role label in user reports and CSV.
athar-report-role-jury: Role name for Contest Jury Member.
